candidate_rule: registered numeric light-3 rig member list excluding the two starting cameras and all six independent evaluation cameras; positions, never photo content or target outcomes, determine eligibility

virtual_query.order: increasing SHA256 of UTF-8 q|137041|<integer candidate id>
virtual_query.rotation: nearest proper SO(3) rotation by SVD of the blended positive-weight rotation matrices
virtual_query.start: equal weights for the two endpoints

random_draw: lowest SHA256 of UTF-8 random|<seed>|<object_id>|<smaller camera id>|<larger camera id> over lexicographically enumerated pairs

grid.representative: first q then y then x, chosen without reference to the magnitude of risk

visibility.mode: nearest integer pixel floor(x+0.5), same el-camera-1 frame and positive clip range
visibility.compare: abs(candidate predicted camera-Z minus reprojected point camera-Z) <= max(absolute term, relative term times point camera-Z)

objective: union over each unordered camera pair; uniform weights one and risk weights original continuous published MS-L1; identical points and visibility both arms
ties: lowest numeric camera pair within 1e-12 * max(1,max absolute utility)
shared_fallback: both coverage arms use the same maximum angular separation of candidate optical axes with numeric pair tie break if support is empty, weight sum <=1e-12 or either complete utility grid is constant within tie tolerance
authorization: For each object, seal five complete separate strategy receipts with both numeric IDs before releasing any candidate photographs. Selector inputs are the two source photos and native self renders, source-only checkpoint, permitted source/candidate/virtual geometry and its predictions. No held-out target poses or photographs in the selector.
reconstruction: cold start, 5000 updates; same source-only 24-track eligibility and original 2048 endpoint fallback; new four source order [24, lower selected ID, higher selected ID, 22]; scene scale fixed from common endpoints
primary_metric: six-view full-crop display-sRGB MAE on independent cameras, paired within physical object, lower is better; compare risk against uniform, random mean and range across three preregistered choices; separately record failure/coverage and missing predictions
secondary_metric: fraction of comparable pixels with strict RGB MAE >0.05; count missing canvases and comparable pixels per branch
unique_fit_rule: same object, ordered sources and all inputs, initialization, optimizer seed and recipe permit aliasing a single immutable fit. No replacement after failure or target inspection.
